**衍射光栅**利用许多靠得很近的狭缝，让光波展开并相互叠加。
衍射是波通过狭缝或经过边缘后，向直线光路以外展开的现象。
透射光栅由大量很窄的平行狭缝组成，相邻狭缝之间是不透明的条纹（图 206）。

狭缝让光通过，不透明条纹挡住光，许多狭缝一起决定最后的明暗图样。
图中的放大镜帮助我们看清密集的平行条纹，不是增加了一组狭缝。
原书介绍，专门的刻划机可以在玻璃平板上刻出平行细线，每 1 毫米可达几千条。

细线总数可以超过 100000 条，所以光栅有许多重复排列的部分。
原书还介绍了夹在两块玻璃平板之间的白明胶光栅印痕。
光栅也可以利用反射光，而不让光穿过玻璃。

原书称**反射光栅**具有最好的质量，并描述了交替反射光和散射光的条纹。
其中散射光的条纹用雕刻刀在磨光的金属平板上刻出。
透射与反射是两种结构，重复的条纹使来自不同位置的波能够相互配合。

A **diffraction grating** uses many closely spaced slits to spread light waves and let them combine.
Diffraction is the spreading of a wave beyond its straight-ahead path after an opening or an edge.

A transmission grating has many narrow, parallel slits separated by opaque strips, as in Figure 206.
The slits transmit light, while the opaque strips block it.

Light from all the slits combines to determine the pattern of brightness.
The magnifying glass makes the closely spaced parallel strips easier to see;

it does not add another set of slits.
The source describes a special ruling machine making parallel lines on a glass plate, with several thousand lines in every 1 millimeter.

The total can exceed 100000 lines, giving the grating many repeating parts.
The source also describes a white-gelatin grating impression held between two glass plates.

A grating can use reflected light instead of transmitting light through glass.
The source calls **reflection gratings** the highest-quality type and describes alternating reflecting and scattering strips.

The scattering strips are cut into a polished metal plate with a cutting tool.
Transmission and reflection are different arrangements, but repeated strips allow waves from different positions to combine.
